name: absurdly-true
description: Convenience scripts for running the frontend and backend together.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
